model.name: Current-role LIVE fix — resolver result read at its real type (.taskUuid, no false as-cast) + canonical bareUuid prevention
model.description: The LIVE current-role bug (D1, measured): currentTaskUuidFromSlots (server.ts:1395) returns '' for EVERY task so all pinRole='other' 2/2 — a designated task's pin never renders current. ROOT (architect ran the resolver, uuid-form hypothesis KILLED — both ids are bare full uuids, NO @host/prefix mismatch): line 1402 casts the slotsFrom result `as { current?: { uuid?: string } }` and reads slots.current.uuid, but ThreeSlots.current is a TaskSlot whose field is taskUuid (CurrentSprint.ts:47, toSlot :331) — .uuid is undefined -> String(undefined||'')='' -> the currentUuid guard short-circuits -> every task 'other'. TypeScript did NOT catch it because the FALSE structural `as` cast told the compiler .uuid exists; the real ThreeSlots type would have ERRORED. The unsafe `as` cast defeated the type checker = the actual hazard, and the cast IS a SECOND DEFINITION of a shared truth (the slot shape). D1 = the screen fix (delete the cast, consume the real type, read .taskUuid). D2 = the LATENT uuid-form normalization class (canonical bareUuid) — prevention, NOT the live fix.

discoverySource.measured: architect ran a probe replicating currentTaskUuidFromSlots vs the live index: DESIGNATION+iorUuid both bare full uuids, currentUuid='' (EMPTY), slots.current={taskUuid:...} -> RAW=== false -> pinRole OTHER, 2/2 both sprints. uuid-form (@host/prefix) hypothesis KILLED.
discoverySource.verifiedBy: robbin-req first-hand: server.ts:1402 `as { current?: { uuid?: string } }` false cast + returns slots.current.uuid; TaskSlot.taskUuid (CurrentSprint.ts:47), toSlot :331 sets {taskUuid:t.uuid} -> .uuid undefined -> ''

model.metaFinding: ★ AN UNSAFE `as` CAST DEFEATED THE TYPE CHECKER = the actual hazard. A FALSE structural cast (`as {current?:{uuid?}}`) is a SECOND DEFINITION of a shared truth (the slot shape): getThreeSlots defines {taskUuid}; the cast re-declared {uuid} and told the compiler .uuid exists, so TS could not catch the wrong-field read. The PO's principle (retire beats repair / one definition of a shared truth) HOLDS — only the mechanism was mis-identified: the shared truth with two definitions was the SLOT SHAPE, not the uuid form. Cure = consume the ONE real exported type, retire the ad-hoc re-declaration (the cast), don't patch the field name blind. Guard the hazard by-construction: 0 ad-hoc `as {…}` casts on resolver results. [[an-as-cast-is-a-second-definition-of-a-type]] [[measure-the-mechanism-before-crediting-the-hypothesis]]
